raw_response:
I farm only 1.5 mu, so I cannot take big risks. What I do is mostly what has worked on my land and what other people here in Quzhou do. For wheat, I will not cut fertilizer too much, because if wheat turns weak in spring, the yield drops fast and I cannot make that back. But I also cannot spend too much, because some people in my family work outside and we still need cash in hand. I have well water, so for wheat I will irrigate at the key times, but not too many times because pumping costs money. After wheat harvest, the maize has to go in quickly. That window is very short here, so I will keep land preparation simple and plant fast with hybrid seed. For maize I still use fertilizer, but a bit less than wheat, and I will watch the rain before deciding on extra irrigation. This year I am aiming for a steady harvest, not anything fancy.
